name: Etihad GO Telecom Co.
summary: Etihad GO Telecom Co. provides telecommunication services for individuals, households, and businesses in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through the Data Services; Voice; and Systems Analysis, Application Design and Development Services segments. The company offers voice, data, broadband internet, internet telephony, international gateway, and landline phone services. It also provides local and international calls including interconnection; internet broadband services to business-to-business (B2B) and business-to consumer (B2C).; and technical consulting services.
